content: To reduce the severity of the class imbalance between in-scope versus out-of-scope query samples (i.e., 15,000 versus 250 queries for OOS+), we investigate two strategies when using oos-binary: one where we undersample the in-scope data and train using 1,000 in-scope queries sampled evenly across all intents (versus 250 out-of-scope), and another where we augment the 250 OOS+ out-of-scope training queries with 14,750 sentences sampled from Wikipedia.
